note: The world map view (roadmap follow-up; core/game/game_world_map.gd, drawn by ui/play/world_map_panel.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). The open world as one picture: the world is sampled every `step` tiles (the middle tile of each cell, its biome and whether it is under water, as GameWorldGen gives them, so the map is always the world the dynasty's seed makes) and each cell is drawn in the tile view's colour for that kind. Over it go a marker for every place on the map (a town, a dungeon or the wilds; one the family has not visited is drawn as unknown, with no name, except a town or a city, which everyone knows), where the family is now (the text game's place), and where the heir stands. Pure: nothing is saved and no dice are drawn, but for the map pin. TRAVEL (core/game/game_travel.gd): a town or city (a place with a town's ground; `cities` are the big ones) can be selected on the map for a card with three actions: Pin it (GameDynasty.map_pin, saved only when set, cleared when the heir comes within `settings.pin_clear_tiles` of the place's anchor (a pin on a bare point: `pin_clear_point_tiles`) or by Unpin; the minimap points at it), Walk there (a route in legs of `travel.leg_tiles`, through a gate by day) and Book travel (from a town's ground to another town for gold: the fare is max(`min_fee`, ceil(tiles * `gold_per_tile`)) times the shop price multiplier, `seconds_per_tile` of the world clock go by, and the heir stands `arrive_in_tiles` inside the gate nearest where they set out, the party beside them). `leg_tries` rotated aims of `leg_turn_deg` degrees each are tried for a leg, a leg must gain `leg_min_gain` tiles, a target is moved to the nearest walkable tile within `snap_tiles`, and a walk that is stopped (a gate shutting) is planned again `replans` times.

text.title: The world
text.legend: Towns and cities are named for everyone (a house marks a town, a castle a city); other places are named once the family has been there. A triangle is the site of a trial the family has found (green once passed). Select a town for its card.
text.trial_none: none yet; a trial's site is found by the first step of its way in
text.card_none: Select a town or a city on the map: its card has Pin it, Walk there and Book travel.
text.pin_set: A pin marks {name} on the map, {tiles} tiles {dir}.
text.pin_cleared: {heir} has come to {name}; the pin comes off the map.
text.pin_bad: There is nothing there to pin.
text.walk_pinned_only: {name} is pinned, but there is no way to walk there from here: {why}
text.walk_shut: The gates of {name} are shut for the night. {heir} waits outside the wall.
text.walk_stalled: {heir} cannot find a way on toward {name}; the pin stays.
text.book_no_town: There is no town of that name to book travel to.
text.book_not_town: Travel is booked from a town's ground; {heir} is not standing in one.
text.book_indoors: Travel is booked out of doors; {heir} is inside.
text.book_upstairs: Travel is booked on the ground, not upstairs.
text.book_fight: There is no booking travel in the middle of a fight.
text.book_busy: The world is waiting on an answer; travel cannot be booked now.
text.book_poor: The fare to {name} is {gold} gold; {heir} has {have}.
text.booked: {heir} books travel from {from} to {name}: {gold} gold for {tiles} tiles, and the coach sets down at the gate.
